Source Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B @ 1d4bf0f2 (Apache-2.0; the text decoder of the multimodal checkpoint: 64 layers = 48 GatedDeltaNet + 16 gated attention). The file is run r5's metadata-only re-pack of the run-1 Mixed INT4 b128 file (9af4ab9e...): TFLite, tokenizer and ExecutorMetadata sections byte-identical, the LlmMetadata section replaced by a template without the thinking switch, no thought channel, supports_thinking false. Thinking off only: with litert-lm 0.18.1's default rewind of the thought between turns (filter_channel_content_from_kv_cache true in ConversationConfig::Builder) the third turn of a thinking-on conversation forgot the user's name on the GPU (3 of 3 fresh processes) and the CPU (1 of 1) on the switch file, while the same file with the filter off and HF bf16 answered. These rows are the r5 runs of the published bytes on the Mac Studio (2026-10-23): the GPU 8-question check, the three-turn conversation with thinking off, and the Hub card's three usage commands run as written. Runs of other bytes are notes, not rows: on the switch file 9af4ab9e... (only the LlmMetadata section differs) the speed comparison, GSM8K n=100 on the GPU 97 vs HF bf16 96, the CPU 8-question check 8 / 8, the decode walk top-1 23 / 24 vs HF bf16 and the three-turn check on the CPU. The usage benchmark here is one process (the protocol's two passes ran on the switch file); a background read of about 1 s ran during its warm-up engine's build, before the timed runs. CPU: the CLI's CPU engine without the weight cache packs the int4 weights once per signature (7) and was stopped at a 91 GB footprint by the swap guard on the 137 GB Mac (2026-10-22, the block-32 file of the same export) - use --cache disk. Precision: the fp32 activation declaration stays; with the runtime's fp16 default the first 8-question item was a run of '!' to the token cap. Mac GPU: across the 11 benchmark processes WebGPU validation errors appeared in 2 of the 44 engines, each the third engine of its process, on two variants (the block-32 file, and the b128 file without the fp32 declaration); none in the 12 benchmark engines that ran this TFLite section (8 on the switch file, 4 here) or in its single-engine processes - a row counts only from logs without such lines. Engine reuse: one Engine per conversation (LiteRT-LM #3165). Phones: no record (a 15.4 GB file is above every phone's memory; header).
quantization: Mixed INT4: int4 blockwise-128 min-max on the linear layers (block scales floored at 2^-14), int8 lm_head and embedding, the 96 GatedDeltaNet decay/gate projections (in_proj_a / in_proj_b) float; fp32 GPU activations declared; 6 prefill signatures (1024 / 256 / 64 / 16 / 4 / 1) + decode, KV cache 4096; thinking off only
